messages:
nia: Hey team — since onboarding aegisx-v1 overnight we've seen p95 ~600ms but p99 for long-context (>8k tokens) requests jumped from ~1.2s to ~4.6s. Customer reports timeouts and slow UIs. Sample request id: req_0a9f3b. Happening across regions (us-east, eu-west). Any quick triage? :frowning:

mike: Thanks @nia — sorry about this. Can you paste a minimal request payload and the model + tokenizer versions? Also, do you have an example customer call ID or logs (trace id)?

nia: payload is a plain chat generate with history ~9k tokens (user + system). model: aegisx-v1, tokenizer: aegisx-bpe-v2. trace id: trace:abc-0a9f3b. Customer repro curl:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <key>" \
  -d '{"model":"aegisx-v1","input":"<long history>","max_new_tokens":256}'
```

samir: Thanks. Quick hypothesis: tokenizer change increased subtoken expansion for some unicode characters -> longer sequences hitting slowpath in the runtime (KV cache pressure + kernel choice). Can you attach a small (anonymized) chunk of the conversation text with non-ASCII chars if present? Also asking infra if kvcache invalidations spiked around the same time.

elaine: I pulled infra metrics for the aegisx fleet. Observations:
- kvcache miss rate for aegisx-v1 increased 3x around 5001230000
- average batch size decreased (many single-request batches) -> kernel selection fell back to slower schedule for long seqs
- no large GC events, but one canary rollout at 5001229000 (deploy-bot below)

deploy-bot: canary/aegisx-v1 rolled to 10% @ 5001229000 by release/infra-team :rocket:

mike: OK good to know. Two immediate repro asks:
1) @nia can you run the failing call with `?debug=tokenize` (we'll echo token counts and per-step timing) and paste the token count and tokenization sample.
2) if possible, switch to model param `tokenizer=bytebpe-v0` in the request to see if the tokenizer is the root cause (this is supported at runtime as a compatibility override).

nia: ran debug. Results:
- input chars: ~48,200
- tokens (aegisx-bpe-v2): 10,980
- tokens (bytebpe-v0): 7,210
- tokenization example (chunk): "\u200bword\u2019s" -> aegisx-bpe-v2 -> 9 subtokens vs bytebpe-v0 -> 3 subtokens
- per-step timing: tokenization 430ms, serve-start 120ms, gen p99 4.5s

samir: That delta is huge — token inflation from the new tokenizer explains the sequence-length blowup. Two effects:
- runtime kernel path picks slow attention algorithm at >8k tokens
- kvcache memory pressure & cache churn -> misses -> recompute

elaine: Suggested mitigations to try now (fast, no infra deploy):
- ask customer to set `tokenizer=bytebpe-v0` override (soft rollback) — avoids model rollout
- set `max_input_tokens` client-side to trim old history until we push a fix
- increase `batch_max_tokens` on serving route temporarily to allow larger batching

mike: I'm patching a support playbook with the above. Also creating a support-only route that pins aegisx-v1 -> aegisx-q8 (quantized variant) which tends to use a different kernel path for long seqs. Will test perf impact.

samir: Longer-term fixes we should consider:
- revert/adjust aegisx-bpe-v2 merges that cause subtoken explosion for certain unicode ranges
- add a tokenizer normalization pre-pass (NFKC) in the ingestion layer with opt-out
- update runtime kernel selection thresholds to avoid catastrophic slowpath at the observed token counts (but risk different perf regressions)

elaine: Quick experiment results (5001234200): pinned requests to bytebpe-v0 override -> p99 dropped to ~1.4s for same payload. Pinned to aegisx-q8 -> p99 ~1.7s. So workaround validated.

mike: I emailed the customer and asked them to try `tokenizer=bytebpe-v0` as immediate mitigation and offered to route traffic to the quantized variant. Customer agreed to test.

nia: Customer tried override and confirmed their UI latency returned to baseline. They reported a 95% reduction in error rate. :thumbsup:

samir: Action items:
- (samir) open PR to revert the aggressive merge rules in aegisx-bpe-v2 and add unit tests for the unicode cases (due EOW) ✅
- (elaine) schedule rollback of canary or pause rollout until tokenizer fix (in progress) ✅
- (mike) update support KB with `tokenizer=...` override steps and add automated runbook (today) ✅
- (infra) add a runtime alarm for token inflation ratio >1.5x on new model rollouts (requested)

elaine: I'm pausing the canary at 5001234500 and initiating a targeted rollback of aegisx-bpe-v2 to previous tokenizer build. Will follow up when rollback completes.

deploy-bot: rollback/aegisx-bpe-v2 initiated @ 5001234510 by infra/sre-team

mike: Closing loop with customer, adding notes to ticket. Will monitor telemetry for next 24h. If anything spikes ping me in this thread.

nia: Thanks all — huge help. Customer is happy for now. Please keep me posted on the PR and rollback status.

elaine: Rollback completed @ 5001234580. Metrics returning to baseline. I'll leave monitoring alert on for 48h.

mike: Marking this thread resolved for support. Filing a postmortem doc link: https://confluence.example/ops/aegisx-tokenizer-latency-5001234567

nia: Thanks :heart:
